To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the maximum reconnection electric field is strongly anticorrelated to the hardness of HXR emission and is strongly correlated to flare magnitude.
the reconnection electric field is a strong function of flare size and that the hardness of X-ray emission from a flare is a strong function the electric field.
the reconnection electric field derived from the ribbon motion is anticorrelated with the hardness of the X-ray emission, which is a measure of the electron energy distribution.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the study of the electric field generated by the magnetic reconnection process in the solar corona.
the relationship between the electric field generated by magnetic reconnection and the hardness of X-ray emissions during solar flares.
the relationship between the magnetic field and the plasma flow in the corona of the Sun.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the reconnection electric field is the main parameter that determines the flare magnitude and the electron acceleration efficiency.
the electric field measured from reconnection is a key factor that governs the hardness of the flare X-ray emission and the flare intensity.
the electric field at the reconnecting current sheet is a key ingredient for the acceleration of electrons during flares.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the electric field is the key parameter for electron acceleration during flares.
the reconnection electric field is the key factor for the flare energy release and the electron acceleration.
reconnection electric field is a key parameter that controls the acceleration of energetic electrons during solar flares.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a large reconnection electric field is needed for a strong electron acceleration, and the latter is the main source for the flare emission.
the electric field at the reconnection site, rather than the magnetic field strength, plays the key role in determining the flare intensity and the hardness of the X-ray spectrum.
the electric field is the key parameter for flare energy release, and the HXR hardness is a good diagnostic for it.
